stories.title: Bitcoin stuck near $64,000 as US bitcoin funds end a 7-day selling streak; Nvidia reports tonight
stories.summary: Bitcoin is trading near $64,000 after a weekend drop to about $62,000. US spot bitcoin funds (ETFs) took in a small amount of new money on Monday, ending a week-long run of withdrawals. Tonight's results from Nvidia, the AI chip maker whose shares often move with crypto, are the next big test.
points: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in a net $7.9M on Monday, ending a seven-day outflow streak; BlackRock's IBIT added $76.5M while Grayscale's GBTC lost $34.6M, per CoinDesk.
Before that, the funds lost about $1.9B over 5-13 November, per Unchained.
Bitcoin is down about 30% since the start of October, per CoinDesk. Over the past week bitcoin fell 14.2%, ether 18.2% and solana 19.7%, per The Block.

Nvidia reports after the US close today, its first report since CEO Jensen Huang resigned, with its call at 5pm ET (05:00 Wednesday Bangkok), per Nvidia. Analysts expect about $108B of revenue, and its shares are about 40% below their October record, per CoinDesk.
Grayscale's research head Zach Pandl blames stablecoin outflows after the Binance hack and the AI-stock selloff for the drop, per The Block.

stories.title: Markets bet on a December Fed rate rise; US retail sales and Fed speakers today
stories.summary: Futures markets treat a Fed interest-rate rise on 9 December as close to certain; the open question is whether it is a quarter point or half a point. Higher rates make cash and bonds pay more, which tends to pull money away from assets like bitcoin. Today's US retail sales and Fed speeches are the next clues.
points: CME FedWatch showed a 90.7% chance of a 0.25-point rise and 9.3% for a 0.5-point rise on Monday evening, per CryptoTicker; Pintu's 16 Nov reading was 93.5% and 6.5%. These are market bets, not a Fed decision.
The 10-year US Treasury yield was 5.15% on 16 Nov, per Pintu.
October retail sales come at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok): forecast +0.2%, September was +0.8%, per Finviz.
Fed Governor Waller speaks at 9:10am ET (21:10 Bangkok), per the Federal Reserve. Minutes of the October Fed meeting come Wednesday at 2pm ET (02:00 Thursday Bangkok).

stories.title: Hackers planted crypto-stealing code on 178 websites, including Ledger's
stories.summary: Attackers abused a flaw in Optimizely, a website-testing tool many companies embed, to slip code onto customer sites that swapped crypto wallet addresses and skimmed card details. The companies' own servers were not breached, and Optimizely says it removed the code. The lesson for everyone: check the first and last characters of any address you paste before you send.
points: 178 organizations were affected, including 6 crypto or trading firms such as Ledger and 32 banks or financial firms, per CoinDesk.
The code swapped wallet addresses for bitcoin, ether, solana, Tron and other chains, both in forms and in copied text, per CoinDesk.
Attacker wallets had received about $7,040 by Monday evening, per Report URI as cited by CoinDesk; the total stolen is not known.

briefs.title: Binance hacker moves $63M of ether
briefs.summary: A wallet tied to North Korea's TraderTraitor group and the Binance hack moved 34,279.66 ETH (about $63M) to new addresses after two weeks quiet, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Solana Foundation buys majority of CoinGecko
briefs.summary: The Solana Foundation took a majority stake in crypto data site CoinGecko, which has 18M registered users; the price was not disclosed, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Senate hearing on CFTC nominees
briefs.summary: Nathan Anonick and Matthew Rowland, nominated to the CFTC, face the Senate Agriculture Committee today; Chair Michael Selig is the agency's only sitting commissioner, per Bitcoin Magazine.

briefs.title: Lighter pauses withdrawals after hack
briefs.summary: Trading platform Lighter paused all withdrawals after a leaked trader API key led to a $10.39M USDC theft, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Ex-Robinhood engineer pleads guilty
briefs.summary: Huaisong Xiang admitted wire fraud for trading on Hyperliquid ahead of Robinhood listing announcements and agreed to forfeit $125,523, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Ark buys crypto stocks, sells Nvidia
briefs.summary: Cathie Wood's Ark bought about $23M of Block, $10.4M of Circle and $6.4M of Coinbase and sold about $84.8M of Nvidia, per The Block.

briefs.title: Strategy keeps buying
briefs.summary: Strategy bought 485 BTC for $33.4M at an average $68,887, taking it to 850,849 BTC at an average cost of $75,452, above the current price, per The Block.
